name: com.xengine.xui
description: AI-first UI application layer on top of XGUI. Compact .xui XML screens assembled into XGUI hierarchies at runtime, logic/render separation, and offline validation through the XEngine AI Host. Official optional package: listed in Package Manager, not mounted until installed.

samples.description: One screen covering theme tokens, a stretched backdrop, a content-sized VStack, a template used twice with parameterised ids, and an action row.

The whole package on one screen: tabs with bound panels, entry and exit transitions, a controller that never touches a GameObject, a modal, a loading overlay, a toast, and translation — including the one label that must not be translated.
A two-state 9-slice button skin authored as a .pxl text grid. Render it with pxl_render to see what the characters draw.
